messages:
Marta: Root alert — rendering queue for ap-northeast1 spiked ~9x, a bunch of pods Pending.
Kevin: a100-hot pool nearly drained, autoscaler not reacting. Spot evictions high.
Jin: kube-scheduler logs: "failed to bind node: insufficient resources" for many render pods.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT created: INC-2026-17799 | ap-northeast1 GPU capacity degradation :rotating_light:
Kevin: provisioner shows IPAM error: "alloc failed: no free ipblocks in ap-northeast1-zone-c" — looks like IPAM exhaustion + evictions.
Lucas: metric pipeline (kinesis) backfilled ~14:10-14:20, autoscaler window could have missed samples.
Jin: paste from autoscaler/provisioner logs:
```E 14:21:03 autoscaler.go:205 aggregated-samples empty for pool=a100-hot
W 14:21:07 provisioner.go:98 request 6 nodes pending: ipam allocation failed
```
Marta: Can we shift some traffic to eu-west1 warm pool as a quick failover to reduce 5xx?
Sam: eu-west1 warm pool available; cold-start p99 ~1.1s. We'll take the latency hit to avoid errors.
Kevin: cost note: routing ~30% -> eu-west1 estimated ~$7k/day for GPUs. Aware but prefer availability for now.
Jin: Proposed mitigation steps:
- disable immediate scale-down on a100-hot
- manually add +6 on-demand nodes to hotpool
- switch autoscaler metric source to prometheus scrape (bypass kinesis gap)
- shift 30% traffic to eu-west1 warm pool
- open IPAM cleanup ticket

Kevin: executing: `redwoodctl pool add --region ap-northeast1 --pool a100-hot --count 6 --type on-demand`
Kevin: CLI: "request accepted, provisioning 6 nodes (2/6 ready). 4 pending (ipam)"
Lucas: starting IPAM scan/cleanup for leaked blocks, filing INFRA-3300.
Marta: rolled back yesterday's cooldown tweak (cfg-2026-0411) -> scale-down = 10m.
Kevin: flipped autoscaler metric source: `--metric-source=prometheus` — autoscaler now getting realtime qps, triggering additional nodes.
Jin: traffic-router: routed 30% to eu-west1; healthchecks passing on fallback path.
oncall-bot: Pager silenced by Marta at 14:40.
Marta: tail 5xx rate back to baseline. p99 still elevated for some render requests hitting warm pool.
Kevin: Follow-ups: IPAM cleanup INFRA-3300, kinesis backlog triage INFRA-3301, postmortem.
Lucas: Postmortem suggestions: add eviction-aware scale-down hold (20m) and IPAM headroom guard for GPU pools.
Sam: Also evaluate reserved on-demand buffer for critical render workloads around product launches (cost vs risk).
Jin: Adding timeline + logs to the incident doc, will attach graphs.
Marta: Monitoring for 2 hours, then re-enable normal scale-down. If stable at 16:40 we'll close incident. :thumbsup:
Kevin: Thanks all, standing by to re-enable once metrics look normal.
